test_successful_auth_call: test the AuthExampleTest to verify successful gRPC authenticated RPC call between client and server
test_no_channel_credential: test the AuthExampleTest to verify UNAVAILABLE status when using an insecure channel without credentials
test_no_call_credential: test the AuthExampleTest to verify UNAUTHENTICATED status when missing call credentials on a secure channel
run_auth_example_tests: run the gRPC Python authentication example tests using unittest with verbosity level 2
review_AuthExampleTest: review the AuthExampleTest class and its three test methods for gRPC authentication scenarios
